commands.name: scaffold_node_app
commands.description: Create a standalone MCP app or ready-to-install Codex plugin app scaffold.

commands.name: validate_app_scaffold
commands.description: Validate a generated MCP app scaffold.

commands.name: check_codex_local_app
commands.description: Check local Codex plugin app state.

commands.name: check_mcp_app_state
commands.description: Inspect MCP app builder plugin state.

commands.name: recreate_mcp_apps_from_urls
commands.description: Recreate MCP app scaffolds from source URLs.

commands.name: connect_codex_app
commands.description: Scaffold/start/register/verify a standalone MCP app or Codex plugin app. Modes: mcp-server | apps-app. Subcommands: up | down | status.
examples: node scripts/connect_codex_app.mjs up --app /tmp/my-app --name "My App" --archetype vanilla-widget --mode mcp-server
node scripts/connect_codex_app.mjs up --app /tmp/my-plugin --name "My Plugin" --archetype vanilla-widget --target codex-plugin --mode mcp-server

commands.name: verify_codex_connection
commands.description: Probe a running MCP app: MCP handshake, tools/list, widget resource read, optional tools/call.
